questions.title: What marks an issue as claimed?

options.title: The assignee plus a `claim:` comment
options.detail: Two signals, one of them naming the run.

options.title: A label
options.detail: One signal, but it names no run.

questions.why: A label cannot say which run holds the claim, so a stale one cannot be told from a live one.
questions.figureSvg: <svg viewBox="0 0 400 60" role="img" aria-label="The assignee and the comment together name the run."><g class="box"><rect x="10" y="14" width="150" height="32" rx="5"/><text x="22" y="34">Assignee</text></g><path class="edge hot" d="M160 30 L230 30"/><g class="box hot"><rect x="230" y="14" width="150" height="32" rx="5"/><text x="242" y="34">claim: comment</text></g></svg>
questions.figureCaption: The comment is what names the run.

questions.title: Where does the claim comment go?

options.title: On the PR once one exists

questions.why: The claim exists before any PR does, and `select` reads issues.
